Name: Governor  to Gourmet
Author: Taelende
Description:
I can't be the only one who saw the similarities in these characters (even if it's only that they're both wearing purple). I mean, there's even food tasting involved. PERFECT opportunity to slip the Gourmet in [s]and make him suffer[/s] and give him some love, amirite?

[b]In lieu of the fact that there is no mod already to do this, I made one.
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]CONTENT PATCHER[/url]

[/b]Just toss it into your mods folder and it will work!

[i]Enjoy[/i]

Downloads.Description: Turn the Governor into Harvest Moon's Gourmet!

Manifest.Name: Gourmet
Manifest.Description: Changes the Governor into the Gourmet from Harvest Moon.
